verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit ships a documented CLI Auth feature that implements the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow (RFC 8628). A device authorization endpoint issues a device code and user code, and the client polls for session tokens. Its OAuth applications docs explicitly cover CLI tools as user-authenticated clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the device flow works in practice, and explicit coverage of headless agent use cases and token refresh/lifetime behavior.
